_doc: Phase 6 plan 06-03 report_slices expected digest, regenerated by plan 14-11 (deliberate move, D-25). EXPECTED_REPORT_DIGEST is the canonical sha256 of the UncertaintyReport built from input.json with experiment_id='0'*64, built_at_utc=2026-09-26T12:00:00Z, bootstrap_seed=42, resamples=10000, probable=0.1, universe_tags as in input.json. The v2 report counts closed filled trades only (END_OF_DATA and plan outcomes are counted apart), carries the NOT_COMPUTED plateau section and states the intrabar totals, so the digest moved from the Phase 6 value. Per D-04, the digest pins every section so any undeclared semantic change fails the acceptance gate.
